topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture on cancer evolution and outlines the core learning outcomes.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution, Natural Selection, and Epigenetic Plasticity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells acquire competitive growth advantages through genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of tissue hierarchy and stemness properties in determining the cell of origin for cancer initiation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external microenvironmental cues and inflammatory signals enable tumor initiation, progression, and maintenance.

topics.label: Technological Methods for Profiling Tumor Biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental and computational technologies used to profile tumor cells and their spatial microenvironments.

topics.label: Multifactorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors integrate into an evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
